title: What changed in prediction markets
insights:
- **Kalshi set a new volume record:** 5.33B contracts on Nov. 7, 31% above its past-week average of 4.06B and just ahead of the previous high, 5.30B on Oct. 24; parlays supplied 4.03B, about three-quarters of the day’s total.
- **Rothera ran well above its recent pace:** It traded 78.7M contracts on Nov. 7, 77% above its past-month average of 44.4M, for about a 1.2% market share.
- **OG/Crypto.com also rose sharply:** Its 122.2M contracts on Nov. 7 were 63% above its past-month average of 75.1M, for about a 1.9% market share.
- **Polymarket US fell below its monthly average:** It traded 446.8M contracts on Nov. 6, 12% under its past-month average of 510.3M, for about a 7% market share.

evidence.label: Additional context 1
evidence.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        platform,
        date,
        contracts,
        fees,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY platform ORDER BY date DESC) AS rn
    FROM competitor_daily
    WHERE platform <> 'Kalshi'
      AND COALESCE(complete, TRUE)
      AND date <= DATE '2026-11-07'
),
latest AS (
    SELECT platform, date, contracts, fees
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    l.platform,
    l.date AS report_date,
    l.contracts AS latest_contracts,
    l.fees AS latest_fees,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.date >= l.date - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND d.date < l.date
             THEN d.contracts ELSE 0 END) / 30.0 AS prior_30_day_avg_contracts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.date >= l.date - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND d.date < l.date
             THEN d.fees ELSE 0 END) / 30.0 AS prior_30_day_avg_fees,
    (l.contracts - SUM(CASE WHEN d.date >= l.date - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND d.date < l.date
                            THEN d.contracts ELSE 0 END) / 30.0)
      / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.date >= l.date - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND d.date < l.date
                        THEN d.contracts ELSE 0 END) / 30.0, 0) * 100 AS pct_change_vs_30_day_avg
FROM latest l
LEFT JOIN competitor_daily d
  ON d.platform = l.platform
 AND COALESCE(d.complete, TRUE)
 AND d.date >= l.date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
 AND d.date <= l.date
GROUP BY l.platform, l.date, l.contracts, l.fees
ORDER BY pct_change_vs_30_day_avg DESC;

evidence.label: Additional context 2
evidence.sql:
WITH daily_type AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        CASE WHEN market_type LIKE 'Parlay%' THEN 'Parlay'
             ELSE market_type END AS market_type,
        SUM(contracts) AS contracts
    FROM sports_market_type_daily
    WHERE date <= DATE '2026-11-07'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS date FROM daily_type
),
types AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT market_type FROM daily_type
),
latest AS (
    SELECT d.market_type, d.contracts
    FROM daily_type d
    JOIN latest_date l USING (date)
),
prior AS (
    SELECT
        d.market_type,
        SUM(d.contracts) / 30.0 AS prior_30_day_avg_contracts
    FROM daily_type d
    CROSS JOIN latest_date l
    WHERE d.date >= l.date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      AND d.date < l.date
    GROUP BY d.market_type
)
SELECT
    l.date AS report_date,
    t.market_type,
    COALESCE(c.contracts, 0) AS latest_contracts,
    COALESCE(p.prior_30_day_avg_contracts, 0) AS prior_30_day_avg_contracts,
    (COALESCE(c.contracts, 0) - COALESCE(p.prior_30_day_avg_contracts, 0))
      / NULLIF(p.prior_30_day_avg_contracts, 0) * 100 AS pct_change_vs_30_day_avg
FROM latest_date l
CROSS JOIN types t
LEFT JOIN latest c ON c.market_type = t.market_type
LEFT JOIN prior p ON p.market_type = t.market_type
ORDER BY latest_contracts DESC;

evidence.label: Additional context 3
evidence.sql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM extreme_trades_daily
    WHERE date = (
        SELECT MAX(date)
        FROM extreme_trades_daily
        WHERE date <= DATE '2026-11-07'
    )
),
prior AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(max_trade_contracts) AS avg_daily_max_trade_contracts,
        AVG(max_taker_loss_usd) AS avg_daily_max_taker_loss_usd
    FROM extreme_trades_daily
    WHERE date >= (SELECT date FROM latest) - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      AND date < (SELECT date FROM latest)
)
SELECT
    l.date,
    l.max_trade_ticker,
    l.max_trade_contracts,
    l.max_taker_loss_ticker,
    l.max_taker_loss_series,
    l.max_taker_loss_contracts,
    l.max_taker_loss_price,
    l.max_taker_loss_usd,
    p.avg_daily_max_trade_contracts AS prior_30_day_avg_daily_max_trade_contracts,
    p.avg_daily_max_taker_loss_usd AS prior_30_day_avg_daily_max_taker_loss_usd
FROM latest l
CROSS JOIN prior p GROUP BY *;

anchor.question: Build the anchor table for today's Predict Charts industry briefing. For each prediction-market venue, use its latest complete reported day and return venue, report date, reported contract volume, the average of its prior seven complete reported days, and percent change versus that average. Use daily_overall for Kalshi and exclude rows where is_partial is true. Use competitor_daily only for platforms other than Kalshi, add ProphetX from prophetx_daily, and add CME from cme_daily. Never use competitor_daily's Kalshi row; it is not the authoritative Kalshi total. In competitor_daily the `complete` column is only populated for Polymarket_US and is NULL for every other platform, where NULL means the row IS complete. Filter it as COALESCE(complete, TRUE) or omit the filter entirely; never write `complete = TRUE`, which silently discards every platform whose flag is NULL. Exclude partial days. CME is the sparse bulletin series; a normal seven-day lookback spanning seven calendar days is regular, not sparse. Resolve the latest complete reported day SEPARATELY FOR EACH VENUE. Do not filter the whole result to one shared calendar date, and do not require a venue to have a row on the newest date any venue reported: a venue whose most recent complete day is a few days old is reporting normally and still belongs in the table, on its own date. Each venue's prior-seven-day baseline is its own prior seven REPORTED days, which for an irregular reporter spans more than seven calendar days. Every one of these ten venues must appear in the result: Kalshi, Polymarket US, ForecastEx, DKeX, Underdog Exchange, OG/Crypto.com, ProphetX, Novig, Rothera, CME. OG/Crypto.com is the platform stored as 'Crypto.com/Nadex'.
anchor.sql:
WITH venue_daily AS (
    SELECT
        'Kalshi' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        CAST(contracts_total AS DOUBLE) AS reported_contract_volume
    FROM daily_overall
    WHERE is_partial IS NOT TRUE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CASE platform
            WHEN 'Polymarket_US' THEN 'Polymarket US'
            WHEN 'Crypto.com/Nadex' THEN 'OG/Crypto.com'
            ELSE platform
        END AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        CAST(contracts AS DOUBLE) AS reported_contract_volume
    FROM competitor_daily
    WHERE platform IN (
        'Polymarket_US',
        'ForecastEx',
        'DKeX',
        'Underdog Exchange',
        'Crypto.com/Nadex',
        'Novig',
        'Rothera'
    )
      AND COALESCE(complete, TRUE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'ProphetX' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        CAST(contracts AS DOUBLE) AS reported_contract_volume
    FROM prophetx_daily
    WHERE complete IS TRUE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'CME' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        CAST(cme_total_vol AS DOUBLE) AS reported_contract_volume
    FROM cme_daily
    WHERE cme_total_vol IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        venue,
        report_date,
        reported_contract_volume,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY venue
            ORDER BY report_date DESC
        ) AS day_rank
    FROM venue_daily
),
latest AS (
    SELECT venue, report_date, reported_contract_volume
    FROM ranked
    WHERE day_rank = 1
),
prior_seven AS (
    SELECT
        venue,
        AVG(reported_contract_volume) AS prior_7_reported_day_avg
    FROM ranked
    WHERE day_rank BETWEEN 2 AND 8
    GROUP BY venue
)
SELECT
    l.venue,
    l.report_date,
    l.reported_contract_volume,
    p.prior_7_reported_day_avg,
    (l.reported_contract_volume - p.prior_7_reported_day_avg)
        / NULLIF(p.prior_7_reported_day_avg, 0) * 100 AS pct_change_vs_prior_7_avg
FROM latest AS l
LEFT JOIN prior_seven AS p USING (venue)
ORDER BY CASE l.venue
    WHEN 'Kalshi' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Polymarket US' THEN 2
    WHEN 'ForecastEx' THEN 3
    WHEN 'DKeX' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Underdog Exchange' THEN 5
    WHEN 'OG/Crypto.com' THEN 6
    WHEN 'ProphetX' THEN 7
    WHEN 'Novig' THEN 8
    WHEN 'Rothera' THEN 9
    WHEN 'CME' THEN 10
END;
